Body.Content:
Microsoft has released a new Windows out-of-band (OOB) update today, November 25, 2026, to address an issue affecting a limited number of Windows Servers with Router Advertisement (RA) enabled that receive time-bound IPv6 routes. Affected devices might stop unexpectedly with stop error 0x139 (KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE) when a route timer expires. This issue affects some Windows Server 2025 devices after installing the November 2026 Windows security hotpatch update.
 
This non-security OOB update is available through Windows Update for Windows Server 2025 devices enrolled in hotpatch updates. It downloads and installs automatically and takes effect without requiring a restart.
 
For complete guidance and installation instructions, see KB5138318.

message.Title: Out-of-band hotpatch update addresses stop error 0x139 on Windows Server 2025
